EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of April 14, 2026 between Halbrook Diagnostics, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 1400 Foundry Road, Chicago, Illinois 60607 (the "Company"), and Devon Achebe (the "Executive").

1. POSITION AND DUTIES. The Company employs the Executive as Vice President, Laboratory Operations, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer. The Executive will devote substantially all business time to the Company.

2. TERM. Employment begins May 1, 2026 and is at will. Either party may end it at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice, subject to Section 7.

3. COMPENSATION. Base salary is $265,000 per year, paid semi-monthly, reviewed annually. The Executive is eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 30% of base salary, subject to the terms of the Company's annual incentive plan.

4. BENEFITS. The Executive is eligible for the Company's health, dental, vision, life, and disability plans, and for four weeks of paid time off per year, on the same terms as other executives.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Executive will not use or disclose the Company's Confidential Information except in performing duties for the Company. This obligation continues after employment ends. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits the Executive from reporting a possible violation of law to a government agency, from participating in an agency investigation, or from making any disclosure protected under 18 U.S.C. § 1833(b), which provides immunity from liability for a confidential disclosure of a trade secret to a government official or an attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law, or in a sealed filing.

6. NON-COMPETITION AND NON-SOLICITATION.
(a) The Executive acknowledges receiving this Agreement at least fourteen (14) calendar days before employment begins and being advised in writing to consult an attorney before signing, as the Illinois Freedom to Work Act, 820 ILCS 90/20, requires.
(b) The Executive's actual or expected annualized earnings exceed $75,000, the threshold the Act sets for a covenant not to compete, and exceed $45,000, the threshold it sets for a covenant not to solicit.
(c) For twelve (12) months after employment ends, the Executive will not perform services substantially similar to those performed for the Company for any business that develops or sells clinical diagnostic assays in Cook, DuPage, Lake, or Will County, Illinois.
(d) For twelve (12) months after employment ends, the Executive will not solicit any employee the Executive supervised or any customer the Executive served in the final twelve months of employment.
(e) These covenants do not apply if the Executive's employment is terminated, furloughed, or laid off as the result of business circumstances or governmental orders related to a public-health emergency, and do not apply to any construction employee or employee covered by a collective bargaining agreement, as the Act provides.
(f) The Company will pay the Executive $22,083 per month during any period these covenants restrict the Executive's employment.

7. SEVERANCE. If the Company ends employment without Cause, the Company will pay twelve months of base salary, in installments, conditioned on a signed release.

8. INVENTIONS. The Executive assigns to the Company all inventions conceived in the course of employment. This assignment does not apply to an invention for which no equipment, supplies, facilities, or trade secret information of the Company was used and which was developed entirely on the Executive's own time, unless the invention relates to the Company's business or actual or demonstrably anticipated research or development, or results from work performed by the Executive for the Company, as 765 ILCS 1060/2 provides.

9. GOVERNING LAW AND VENUE. Illinois law governs this Agreement, and venue lies in the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois.

10. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

HALBROOK DIAGNOSTICS, INC.                EXECUTIVE

By: /s/ Marisol Trent                     /s/ Devon Achebe
Name: Marisol Trent                       Devon Achebe
Title: Chief Executive Officer            Date: April 14, 2026
